canonical_name: No Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
description: Information security roles and responsibilities are not defined and allocated according to organizational needs.
applicability: Applies when an organization has not formally defined and documented security roles, responsibilities are not clearly allocated, or personnel are unclear about their information security obligations.

metadata.detection_notes: Review organizational charts and role descriptions for security responsibilities, interview personnel about their security obligations, assess RACI matrices for security functions, verify documentation of security role assignments.
